Transformers are a good choice of architecture to ground spatio-temporal natural language descriptions and that object identity is a key architectural bias for this task.

(1) the Transformer is an appropriate model for spatio-temporal grounding; (2) maintaining object identity in Transformer attention is instrumental to generalization; (3) summarizing object traces into a single token has a negligible effect on performance.
